CORE FIX IN PROGRESS

Round 25 · The rebuild, measured against the real thing

Look first. Measure second.

The owner played the 9.3 build and called it “pretty bad.” The judges had drifted into scoring element-by-element arcade fidelity — the biomes, the canyon, the tanker all genuinely match the arcade frames — while the game is bad to play: pressing the missile button at enemies fires nothing (the signature AB2 weapon needs an obscure camp-to-lock move no player would find), and the jet + enemy sprites aren’t good enough. Fidelity of parts is not a good game. The judging is recalibrated to score naive play, the build is honestly ~5, and this round fixes the core instead of adding more backdrop.
“No missiles, no heat-seeking missiles; the UI/sprites — both my jet and the enemies — are not good enough; overall pretty bad.”
The owner, after playing the build — the ground truth that outranks every judge

Ours vs the arcade

Shipped this round

held up under the judge’s re-measure
  • RECALIBRATED the judging — the score now anchors on a full NAIVE playtest (play like a first-timer, no insider moves)
  • Weapons-usability + controls-feel + sprite quality are scored ABOVE backdrop fidelity; re-baselined (5-6 = this build)

Fixing now — R25

ranked by what breaks the illusion
  1. 01 BUG
    Missiles don’t work for a player — make them arcade-simple

    AB2’s signature: point the reticle at enemies, press the button, it locks what’s near your aim and fires HOMING heat-seekers that chase them down. Ours needs camping a lock band — a naive player fires none. Rip out the barrier; a first-timer pressing X at enemies gets locks and kills within seconds.

  2. 02 FEEL
    The sprites aren’t good enough — the jet AND the enemies

    The owner singled out both. A real art-quality redraw of the player F-14 (on screen 100% of the time) and the enemy aircraft against the arcade — crisper, more characterful, not flat/toylike. Not a palette tweak.

  3. 03 FEEL
    Then re-judge the whole feel at naive play

    Once missiles work and the sprites improve, does it feel like AB2 in the hands? The recalibrated judge plays naively and scores the PLAY, not the frames.

  4. 04 MISSING
    Deferred: the backdrop work

    The flat field biomes, more stages, canyon density — all genuinely ahead of the gameplay already. Not this round; the core comes first.

Keep — do not regress

  • The backdrop fidelity that IS right: 7 biomes, both refuel beats, the structured canyon, matched airframes
  • The things that work: the gun, the afterburner, the refuel beats, the death cycle, the stage variety
  • The recalibrated calibration — score naive PLAY, owner outranks the judge, don’t inflate on frame-match

This is the R12 failure re-emerging and being caught again — by the owner. The judges re-measure ELEMENT FIDELITY (which climbs) and under-weight whether the game is good to PLAY (which is the point). The signature missile was unusable for 13 rounds while every judge passed it by testing DELIBERATE play, never naive play. The fix is a harder anchor: the judge plays like the owner, and the owner outranks the judge. History in judging/; recalibration in CLAUDE.md.
